description: This file defines the GeneralRuntimeException class, a custom exception class extending RuntimeException, with support for nested exceptions and additional message handling.

classes.name: GeneralRuntimeException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class that supports nested exceptions and enhanced message handling.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException
methods.description: Default constructor generating a new exception with no message.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message string to describe the exception.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Throwable as a nested cause.

methods.name: GeneralRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts both a message and a nested Throwable.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the exception message, including the nested exception's message if present.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage
methods.description: Returns only the message of this exception without nested exception info.

methods.name: getNested
methods.description: Retrieves the nested Throwable if any.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the combined stack trace of this exception and nested exception to System.err.

methods.description: Prints the combined stack trace to a specified PrintStream.

methods.name: printStackTrace(PrintWriter pw)
methods.description: Prints the combined stack trace to a specified PrintWriter.
